marketplace.name: Pine extensions
marketplace.description: Extensions for Pine that are not built in

extensions/keeper.name: Keeper
extensions/keeper.description: The Keeper dashboard as a panel, a count of queries waiting for your approval, and a notice that opens the approval queue when one arrives. The extension only reads the queue; approving is always your click in the dashboard.

notify.title: Approval notifications
notify.description: Notify when a query starts waiting for your approval

pollSeconds.title: Active check interval
pollSeconds.description: Time between queue checks while {product} is focused or approvals wait

idlePollSeconds.title: Background check interval
idlePollSeconds.description: Time between queue checks in the background with nothing waiting

extensions/model-runtime.name: Model runtime
extensions/model-runtime.description: Your local model-runtime as the assistant: a chat pane, typo fixes and prompt review before you send to an agent, command suggestions and completions at the prompt, editor completions and Explain error, with model load and unload in Settings → Assistant → Models. Requests go only to the runtime's socket on this computer.

baseUrl.title: Address
baseUrl.description: Runtime address: unix:/path.sock or an http(s) URL. Empty uses $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/model-runtime.sock.

fastModel.title: Fast model
fastModel.description: Small, fast model for typo fixes, prompt review, command suggestions and completions. Empty uses gemma. Settings → Assistant → Models lists what the runtime has.

chatModel.title: Chat model
chatModel.description: Model for the chat pane and Ask. Empty uses the fast model.

typos.title: Typo fixes
typos.description: Offer typo fixes for prompts you compose for an agent

promptReview.title: Prompt review
promptReview.description: Review the quality of prompts you compose for an agent

commandSuggest.title: Command suggestions
commandSuggest.description: Suggest a shell command from a plain-language request at the prompt

terminalCompletions.title: Terminal completions
terminalCompletions.description: Ghost-text completion of the command you are typing at a shell prompt (sends the line, the folder, recent commands with exit codes and pane chips such as the git branch; never output)

editorCompletions.title: Editor completions
editorCompletions.description: Inline completions in the editor (sends the code around the cursor)

chat.title: Chat
chat.description: The assistant chat pane and Ask in the command palette

explainError.title: Explain error
explainError.description: Explain error on a failed command block (sends that command and its output when you click it)

requestsPerMinute.title: Request limit
requestsPerMinute.description: Most requests per minute for each feature

extensions/trellis.name: Trellis
extensions/trellis.description: Your Trellis boards: the web UI as a panel, open and claimed cards per workspace, and a notice that opens the card when an agent moves it to review or blocked.

commands.title: Open and claimed cards for this workspace's project

notifyReview.title: Notify on review
notifyReview.description: Notify when an agent moves a card to a review column

notifyBlocked.title: Notify on blocked
notifyBlocked.description: Notify when an agent moves a card to a blocked column

refreshSeconds.title: Card count refresh
refreshSeconds.description: Time between card count refreshes in the sidebar
